name: Clean girl

influenced_by: minimalist "your skin but better" beauty marketing

reacts_against: heavy, contoured "Instagram baddie" makeup, presenting a minimal, dewy, low-effort-looking beauty standard instead — a standard that drew criticism for relying on genetics and expensive products despite its "effortless" marketing.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Slicked-back bun ("facelift" hairstyle), minimalist makeup, claw clips, gold hoop earrings, "model off-duty" athleisure, matching workout sets, green juice/iced coffee

Minimalism

findings: mostly muted — about 75% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
